verdict.rationale: Bridge, the stablecoin orchestration and issuance part of this offering, documents a sandbox for testing integrations without moving real money. Stripe also documents `stripe sandbox create`, which provisions an anonymous sandbox with working API keys and no account registration, a good fit for agent-driven testing. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that stablecoin payments, onramp, payouts and Treasury balances are exercisable in Stripe sandboxes; independent or hands-on corroboration of crypto testing in sandbox.
